definitions.usage: affliction, breach, breaking, broken(-footed, -handed), bruise, crashing, destruction, hurt, interpretation, vexation.
definitions.full: H7667. sheber I. שֵׁ֫בֶר שֶׁ֫בֶר, noun masculine Jer 4:5 breaking, fracture, crushing, breach, crash ; — absolute שֶׁבֶר Isa 51:19 +, שָׁ֑בֶר Lam 3:47 ; Prov 17:19 , construct שֶׁבֶר Isa 1:28 +, שֵׁבֶר Amos 6:6 +; suffix שִׁבְרִי Jer 10:19 , etc.; plural שְׁבָרִים Josh 7:5 ; Job 41:17 (dubious, see below), suffix שְׁבָרֶיהָ Psa 60:4 ; — 1 breaking of pottery Isa 30:14 , fracture of member, limb Lev 21:19 ; 24:20 (H), especially figurative of people personified ׳שׁ יוֺסֵף Amos 6:6 , compare Isa 30:26 (|| מַכָּתוֺ מַחַץ ), Jer 8:21 ; 10:19 ; 14:17 ; 30:12 (|| מַכָּה ), 30:15 (|| מַכְאֹב ), Lam 2:11 ; 3:48 ; 4:10 , also (with רפה רפא, heal ) Jer 6:14 ; 8:11 ; Lam 2:13 ; Psa 60:4 , compare Nahum 3:19 ; of sinners Isa 1:28 ; shattering , crushing, of wall (in figurative) 30:13 ; ׳שׁ גָּדוֺל || (רָעָהׅ Jer 4:6 ; 6:1 , ׳עַלשֿׁ׳שׁ 4:20 ; וָשׁ ׳שֹׁד Isa 59:7 ; 60:18 ; Jer 48:3 , compare Isa 51:19 ; וְהַשּׁ ׳הַשֵּׁאת Lam 3:47 ; שׁ ׳זַעֲקַת Isa 15:5 , compare Jer 48:5 ; of individual Prov 16:18 ; 17:19 ; 18:12 ; figurative, ׳שׁ רוּחַ crushing of spirit, compare 15:4 ; so ( רוּחַ omitted) מִשְּׁבָרִים Job 41:17 from terror , Di De, compare Bi, but dubious; Buhl Bu conjectures יָם מִשְׁבְּרֵי , Gie גִּבֹּרִים מִשִּׁנָּיו , Du מִשְׁמָרִים . 2 crashing , Zeph 1:10 (|| יְלָלָה צְעָקָה, קוֺל ), Jer 50:22 (|| מִלְחָמָה ), 51:54 (|| זְעָקָה קוֺל ). 3 breaking of a dream, i.e. its interpretation ( solution of mystery) Judg 7:15 (compare GFM). 4 הַשְּׁבָרִים Josh 7:5 , perhaps (Di Benn Steuern) the quarries as proper name, of a location, ᵑ9 Sabarim (> הִשָּֽׁבְרָם ᵑ7 ᵑ6 ᵐ5 ). — שִׁבְרִי Ezek 32:9 , read ᵐ5 שִׁבְיְךָ Co Sta Berthol Krae (not Toy).

Their feet run to evil,
